test_title: PYST 11: SSC MTS 2023 - English (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

They __are sell their company’s__ products to people.
solution:
The correct answer is: **are selling their company’s.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The original sentence has a **subject-verb agreement **issue.
 
• **"They"** is **plural**, so the correct verb form should be **"are selling"**.
 
• "Are selling their company’s products" correctly matches the plural subject "They" with the present continuous verb form "are selling".
 
• **"Their"** is the possessive pronoun that correctly shows ownership of** "company’s products"**.
 
• "Their company’s products" correctly identifies the possession of the products by the company.

Therefore, the corrected sentence is: *They **are selling their company’s** products to people*.
